abstract: Evaluates exchanger integration engineering and heat exchanger operational specs
system_message:
You are the Process engineering superintendent (PROC), responsible for evaluating exchanger integration engineering and heat exchanger operational specifications across candidate energy service companies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates exchanger integration engineering and heat exchanger operational specs（HEAT）
information_points.content:
PROC-HEAT-WCD：According to the piping and instrumentation tie-in audit across the crude distillation unit flue gas duct, Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium lacks certified baseline heat exchanger integration capability.
PROC-HEAT-DTZ：The piping and instrumentation tie-in audit for the crude distillation unit flue gas duct confirms that Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics possesses certified baseline heat exchanger integration capability.
PROC-HEAT-T69：Based on the piping and instrumentation tie-in audit for the crude distillation unit flue gas duct, AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions has certified baseline heat exchanger integration capability.

information_points.title: Demineralized water feed（WATER）
information_points.content:
PROC-WATER-R8J：As recorded in the boiler feedwater utility log for continuous operations, Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium has a treated water consumption rate of 25 m3/h.
PROC-WATER-2QO：Continuous operational records in the boiler feedwater utility log show a treated water consumption rate of 15 m3/h for Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics.
PROC-WATER-NUQ：The boiler feedwater utility log indicates that the treated water consumption rate for AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions during continuous operations is 35 m3/h.
